{{Attr|Stun}} }} {{QuoteContainer|{{QuoteBox|*Heavy footsteps.*|Beginning of Wave 39 ([[Golden Mode|Golden]])}}}} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''24 Karat''' is a golden [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, which is exclusive to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It has slightly fast speed while having health comparable to that of the [[Slow Boss]]. Its main trait was the fact that it is immune to splash damage due to it being a golden enemy. This means that most splash damage that comes from a tower, such as the [[Rocketeer]], is useless against this. The '''24 Karat''' can be spawned by the [[Gold Titan]], and by the [[Mystery Boss]] upon its death in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, from wave 38 onwards. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''24 Karat''' has no face and is colored gold from head to legs. It is slightly larger than the [[Golden]]. The '''24 Karat''' wears a short-sleeved shirt and a gold necktie. The shirt and legs are a different shade of gold compared to its arms. It also wears a golden fedora. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''24 Karat''' was nearly the same as the [[Golden]], except that it wore a golden fedora. Additionally, the '''24 Karat''' used the glass material. Its head and fedora were bright golden, while its torso and legs were a slightly darker of gold. }} ==Strategy== *Due to their high health and above average speed, high DPS towers such as the [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]] and [[Turret]] are recommended against this. *The '''24 Karat''' is immune to splash damage. Towers that deal splash damage, like the [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]] and [[Demoman]], are useless against this [[Enemies|enemy]] as they deal no damage. **It is not, however, immune to all forms of splash damage. The [[Paintballer]], [[Hallow Punk]], [[Grenade]], [[AirStrike]] and [[Nuke]] can still damage it. *You can slow down the '''24 Karat''' by using the [[Freezer]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Electroshocker]]. **As it has the [[Stun Immunity]], it cannot be knocked back or stunned, only slowed down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} 24Karat-1.png|Second version, second animation (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) 24karatremastered.png|First version, first animation (15 August 2019 – 13 October 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} Corpse24Karat.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|'''24 Karat''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} 24KaratIconIG.png|'''24 Karat''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *'''24 Karat''' is a reference to 24 karat (or 24 carat) gold, which is 99.99% pure gold. **This makes the metal very soft, meaning that it is not stronger than lower karats of gold. *Because of the [[Mystery Boss]], the '''24 Karat''' can appear before its first wave appearance in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. ==Update History== *'''15 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.10|BETA v1.10.0]] **'''24 Karat''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **Appearance changed. **Health increased from 1,050 to 1,600. **First wave appearance changed from wave 59 to wave 39 on Hard mode (later [[Golden Mode|Golden]] Mode). *'''14 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.7|Release v1.7.0]] **[[Partial Electric Immunity]] added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0]] **'''24 Karat''' removed. **'''NOTE''': While the '''24 Karat''' was removed in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], one change was made to it, though it could never be seen in-game due to its removal. That change is: ***[[Partial Electric Immunity]] replaced with [[Energy Immunity]]. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.4]] **'''24 Karat''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode and appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. **Now has the [[Stun Immunity]] instead of the [[Energy Immunity]]. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.5]] **'''24 Karat''' can no longer be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0|v1.53.3]] **'''24 Karat''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode and appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. {{Golden|[[Summoner Boss]]|Wave 36|24 Karat|Wave 39|[[Gold Guard]] & [[Gold Titan]]|Wave 40}} {{Hard|[[Golden]]|Wave 58|24 Karat|Wave 59|[[Gold Titan]]|Wave 60}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
